service.en: Academic record To Whom It May Concern certificate
service.ar: شهادة لمن يهمه الأمر بالتسلسل الدراسي

about: Get a certificate listing the grade attended in each year from Grade 1 to 12.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Academic record To Whom It May Concern certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For government schools and private schools that follow the ministry curriculum
channels: MOE website or mobile app, sign in with UAE PASS
